title: Director at Digital Consulting Firm Expects DocuSign Business to Grow 10% in 2026 as It Gains Share
expert: PMO Director, Salesforce business unit at a mid-market digital consulting firm; Docusign ~60%–65% of its document-workflow implementations
verdict: The expert's Docusign-related practice grew roughly 20% y/y in Aug–Oct 2026, but envelopes and seats were roughly flat, so the growth is implementation work and IAM pricing rather than core volume.

Back to double-digit growth: 🟢 **Practice up roughly 20% y/y** in Aug–Oct 2026, deal closures +~20%; first read from this partner.
🟡 **Envelopes and seats roughly flat**: high-tech growth offset by manufacturing and physical goods.
IAM adoption: 🟢 **IAM-related price rise of approximately 20%** on lower plans, perhaps 10% on business plans; Cleveland saw 20-40%+ IAM ACV uplift on some deals (SB #45920): consistent.
🟢 **Intelligent-management tools growing 20%–30%** (estimate), IAM penetration 10%–15% of observed base.
DBNR / renewal expansion: 🟡 **CLM growth 8%–10%** (estimate) vs Cleveland CLM net-new deal volume down Y/Y (SB #63588): **conflicting**.

changes: IAM price increase ~20% on lower plans (expert) vs Cleveland 20-40%+ ACV uplift on some IAM deals (SB #45920) and ~5-10% typical (SB #63574): consistent with the upper end.
CLM growth 8%–10% (expert estimate) vs Cleveland net-new CLM deal volume down Y/Y (SB #63588): conflicting.
First read on envelope and seat volume (roughly flat); no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Stance (neutral; DD growth on the IAM bet): ↑ — practice +~20% y/y; CY26 ~10% expected (estimate), but core volume flat.
Stance (IAM bet): ↑ — ~20% IAM price uplift and 20%–30% intelligent-tool growth (estimate).
